definitions.explanation: A night when the minimum temperature does not fall below 25°C (77°F). An official meteorological term indicating uncomfortably warm nighttime temperatures.

examples.japanese: {昨夜|さくや}は{熱帯夜|ねったいや}だった。
examples.english: Last night was a tropical night.

examples.japanese: {熱帯夜|ねったいや}で{眠|ねむ}れなかった。
examples.english: I couldn't sleep because of the tropical night.

examples.japanese: {熱帯夜|ねったいや}が{続|つづ}くと{体調|たいちょう}を{崩|くず}しやすい。
examples.english: Consecutive tropical nights make it easy to get sick.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{熱帯|ねったい} (tropical) + {夜|や} (night)

DEFINITION:
A night where the lowest temperature stays at or above 25°C. Common during Japanese summers, especially in urban areas due to the heat island effect.

HEALTH NOTES:
{熱帯夜|ねったいや} can lead to sleep deprivation and heat-related illness. Air conditioning use is recommended.

RELATED TERMS:
- {真夏日|まなつび}: hot summer day (over 30°C)
- {猛暑日|もうしょび}: extremely hot day (over 35°C)
- {熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}: heatstroke
